verification.notes: The 1980 paper itself identifies Paul E. Vallely as commander of the 7th Psychological Operations Group and Michael A. Aquino as the group's PSYOP Research & Analysis Team Leader; Aquino's 2003 introduction says he drafted the paper at Vallely's request and that Vallely reviewed and annotated successive drafts. Contemporaneous January 2026 reporting states that TPUSA's website listed Vallely on its advisory council/advisory board. The substance is supported, but 'Turning Point USA board member' is imprecise because the documented role was advisory council membership, not membership on TPUSA's corporate Board of Directors.
